name: PLAN_APPROACH
definition: decompose the task into an ordered set of sub-goals before acting
distinguish: setting the goal hierarchy (here) vs pursuing a sub-goal (any L2 phase)

name: EXPLORE_REPOSITORY
definition: build a map of repo structure
distinguish: going to a directory (here) vs opening a known file to read (INSPECT/READ_SOURCE)

name: LOCATE_CODE
distinguish: searching to acquire a target (here) vs reading the target once found (INSPECT)

name: READ_SOURCE
definition: understand an implementation by reading it
distinguish: reading to understand, no truth test (here) vs reading to pull a specific value (EXTRACT) vs to test a proposition (VERIFY)

name: READ_DOCUMENTATION
distinguish: reading docs (here) vs reading code (READ_SOURCE)

name: INSPECT_CHANGES
distinguish: scanning your own diff (here) vs project source (READ_SOURCE) vs history (INSPECT_HISTORY)

name: INSPECT_HISTORY
definition: understand how code reached its current state
distinguish: scanning past history (here) vs your own diff (INSPECT_CHANGES)

name: INSPECT_ENVIRONMENT
definition: see what is installed / the interpreter state
distinguish: scanning env state (here) vs reading repo source (READ_SOURCE)

name: DIAGNOSE_FAILURE
definition: lock onto a failure and pull out its root-cause value (the offending line/assertion)
distinguish: extracting THE cause from a failure (here) vs general reading-to-understand (INSPECT). [coauthor: EXTRACT vs INSPECT — confirm]

name: RUN_TEST_SUITE
definition: is the behaviour correct? (first/observational test run)
distinguish: proposition = tests pass? Initial run (here) vs post-edit confirmation (VERIFY_FIX)

name: REPRODUCE_ISSUE
definition: does the reported bug actually occur?
distinguish: proposition = bug reproduces? (here) vs the test suite (RUN_TEST_SUITE)

name: VERIFY_FIX
distinguish: post-edit confirmation (here) vs an initial run (RUN_TEST_SUITE/REPRODUCE_ISSUE)

name: CHECK_TYPES
distinguish: static-analysis proposition (here) vs dynamic tests (RUN_TEST_SUITE)

name: RUN_LINTER
distinguish: style proposition (here) vs type soundness (CHECK_TYPES)

name: COMPARE_OUTPUT
distinguish: equality proposition over two artifacts (here) vs reviewing one's own git diff (INSPECT_CHANGES)

name: MEASURE_PERFORMANCE
distinguish: performance proposition (here) vs correctness (RUN_TEST_SUITE)

name: EDIT_SOURCE
distinguish: behavioural fix (here) vs temp prints (ADD_DEBUG_INSTRUMENTATION) vs no-op restructure (REFACTOR_CODE) vs test file (WRITE_TEST)

name: WRITE_TEST
distinguish: kept test (here) vs throwaway repro (WRITE_REPRODUCTION_SCRIPT)

name: WRITE_REPRODUCTION_SCRIPT
definition: externalize a scratch script that triggers the bug
distinguish: scratch repro (here) vs kept test (WRITE_TEST)

name: ADD_DEBUG_INSTRUMENTATION
distinguish: temp diagnostics (here) vs the actual fix (EDIT_SOURCE). NB: when motivated by a failure the CONTROL STATE is REPAIR, the realized CPA is this WRITE

name: FORMAT_CODE
distinguish: mechanical reformat (here) vs behavioural change (EDIT_SOURCE)

name: REFACTOR_CODE
distinguish: no behaviour change (here) vs a fix (EDIT_SOURCE)

name: CONFIGURE_ENVIRONMENT
definition: make the code/tests runnable (env vars, venv)
distinguish: preparing the runtime (here) vs installing packages (INSTALL_DEPENDENCY)

name: MANAGE_FILESYSTEM
distinguish: filesystem op (here) vs editing contents (EDIT_SOURCE) vs deleting scratch (CLEANUP_ARTIFACTS)

name: INSTALL_DEPENDENCY
distinguish: installing deps (here) vs building (BUILD_PROJECT)

name: BUILD_PROJECT
distinguish: building (here) vs installing deps (INSTALL_DEPENDENCY)

name: APPLY_PATCH
definition: externalize a prepared patch onto the tree
distinguish: applying a patch (here) vs hand-editing (EDIT_SOURCE)

name: CLEANUP_ARTIFACTS
distinguish: removing scratch (here) vs reverting a source edit (REVERT_CHANGE)

name: COMMIT_CHANGES
distinguish: committing (here) vs undoing (REVERT_CHANGE)

name: SUBMIT_SOLUTION
definition: externalize the final patch as the solution
distinguish: terminal submission (here) vs intermediate write (EDIT_SOURCE)

name: REVERT_CHANGE
definition: undo an edit that failed or regressed
distinguish: restoring prior state (here) vs a new change (EDIT_SOURCE)

name: INTERACTIVE_DEBUG
definition: drop into a debugger/REPL to inspect runtime state after a failure
distinguish: interactive runtime override (here) vs adding print statements (ADD_DEBUG_INSTRUMENTATION, a WRITE)
